name: r7-auth-owner-scoped
description: devices.user_id and irrigation_zones.user_id stored as TEXT, REAL (incl. +-Infinity) or BLOB on zone config (owner embedded in SQL text), daily schedule with a valid body, zone and device rename, device claims over an existing row (409 check and claim fence), and the valve routes. Record --scoped.

steps.sql: SELECT id, typeof(user_id) AS t, quote(user_id) AS v FROM irrigation_zones WHERE id >= 250 ORDER BY id
SELECT deveui, user_id, typeof(user_id) AS t, name FROM devices WHERE deveui LIKE 'A84041000000B%' OR deveui LIKE 'A84041000000D%' ORDER BY deveui
